newsitem.title: USA: Pepsico says names Sean Orr as controller.
newsitem.headline: Pepsico says names Sean Orr as controller.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc said Monday that its has named Sean Orr as senior vice president and controller. Orr was most recently the chief financial officer of its North American Frito-Lay snack division.
Orr replaces Robert Carleton, who served as PepsiCo's controller for the past 15 years, the company said in a statement.
PepsiCo said Carleton will become the controller of TRICON Global Restaurants Inc, the $10 billion company it plans to spin off to shareholders later this year.
Prior to joining PepsiCo in 1994, Orr was vice president and controller for The Reader's Digest Association and a partner at the accounting firm KPMG Peat Marwich, PepsiCo said.
The company added that after the spin-off, TRICON will consist of the Pizza Hut, KFC, and Taco Bell restaurant franchises.
